mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user su JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=su.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE su.id=#{userId} AND su.status='active' AND p.permission_key=#{permission} AND ((ur.scope_type='data_source' AND ur.scope_id=CAST(#{sourceId} AS CHAR)) OR (r.role_key='platform_admin' AND ur.scope_type='global' AND ur.scope_id='*')))

SELECT sw.sensor_id, GREATEST(sw.window_start, #{from}) ws, LEAST(sw.window_end, #{to}) we, sw.flows_seen, sw.flows_emitted, sw.flows_dropped, sw.queue_depth_max FROM sensor_health_window sw WHERE sw.sensor_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT ib.sensor_id FROM ingest_batch ib WHERE ib.data_source_id=#{sourceId} AND ib.sensor_id IS NOT NULL) AND sw.window_end > #{from} AND sw.window_start < #{to} ORDER BY sw.sensor_id, sw.window_start

SELECT r.quality_status, ir.status inference_status, ir.error_code, ir.reject_reason, ir.binary_label, COUNT(*) n FROM ingest_record r JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.id=r.batch_id LEFT JOIN inference_request ir ON ir.ingest_record_id=r.id WHERE GROUP BY r.quality_status, ir.status, ir.error_code, ir.reject_reason, ir.binary_label

SELECT jt.code, COUNT(*) n FROM ingest_record r JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.id=r.batch_id CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(r.quality_issues_json, '$[*]' COLUMNS (code VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.code')) jt WHERE AND r.quality_status='rejected' GROUP BY jt.code

SELECT jt.field code, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) n FROM ingest_record r JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.id=r.batch_id JOIN inference_request ir ON ir.ingest_record_id=r.id AND ir.status='succeeded' CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(r.quality_issues_json, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( issue VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.code', field VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.field')) jt WHERE AND jt.issue='CATEGORY_OUT_OF_VOCABULARY' GROUP BY jt.field

SELECT COALESCE(ir.asset_id, 0) asset_id, STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(da.detected_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') alert_hour, COUNT(*) n FROM detection_alert da JOIN ingest_record ir ON ir.id=da.ingest_record_id JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.id=ir.batch_id WHERE da.alert_type='model' AND ib.data_source_id=#{sourceId} AND da.detected_at >= #{from} AND da.detected_at < #{to} GROUP BY COALESCE(ir.asset_id, 0), alert_hour

SELECT da.id, da.alert_key, da.detected_at, da.severity, da.score, fs.label, fs.review_status FROM detection_alert da JOIN ingest_record ir ON ir.id=da.ingest_record_id JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.id=ir.batch_id LEFT JOIN feedback_sample fs ON fs.active_alert_id=da.id WHERE da.alert_type='model' AND ib.data_source_id=#{sourceId} AND da.detected_at >= #{from} AND da.detected_at < #{to} ORDER BY da.id

SELECT ir.model_version_id, mv.version, mv.artifact_sha256, COUNT(*) n FROM inference_request ir JOIN ingest_record r ON r.id=ir.ingest_record_id JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.id=r.batch_id JOIN model_version mv ON mv.id=ir.model_version_id WHERE AND ir.status='succeeded' GROUP BY ir.model_version_id, mv.version, mv.artifact_sha256
SELECT id FROM model_version WHERE artifact_sha256=#{artifactSha256} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT CAST(manifest_json AS CHAR) FROM model_version WHERE id=#{modelId}

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, ib.started_at, MAX(ir.completed_at)) DIV 1000 FROM ingest_batch ib JOIN ingest_record r ON r.batch_id=ib.id JOIN inference_request ir ON ir.ingest_record_id=r.id WHERE AND ir.completed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ib.id, ib.started_at HAVING SUM(ir.status='succeeded') > 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oe.id) FROM outbox_event oe JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.id=CAST(oe.aggregate_id AS UNSIGNED) LEFT JOIN consumed_message cm ON cm.consumer='ingest.batch.received' AND cm.message_key=oe.event_key WHERE oe.aggregate_type='ingest_batch' AND AND (oe.status='dead_letter' OR cm.status='dead_lettered')

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumed_message cm JOIN outbox_event oe ON oe.event_key=cm.message_key AND oe.aggregate_type='ingest_batch' JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.id=CAST(oe.aggregate_id AS UNSIGNED) WHERE cm.consumer='ingest.batch.received' AND cm.status='retrying' AND ib.data_source_id=#{sourceId}) consumer_retrying, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox_event oe JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.id=CAST(oe.aggregate_id AS UNSIGNED) WHERE oe.aggregate_type='ingest_batch' AND oe.status IN ('pending', 'failed') AND ib.data_source_id=#{sourceId}) outbox_pending, (SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, MIN(oe.created_at), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) / 1000000 FROM outbox_event oe JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.id=CAST(oe.aggregate_id AS UNSIGNED) WHERE oe.aggregate_type='ingest_batch' AND oe.status IN ('pending', 'failed') AND ib.data_source_id=#{sourceId}) oldest_pending_seconds
